```{=html}
<style>
.wn-header {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a2a4a 0%, #2d4a8c 60%, #3a5aad 100%);
  color: #f5f0e8;
  padding: 1.4rem 2rem;
  border-radius: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
}
.wn-header .wn-title {
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin: 0 0 0.25rem;
}
.wn-header .wn-title span { color: #a2b8f0; }
.wn-header .wn-sub {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  opacity: 0.85;
  margin: 0;
}

.wn-search-row { position: relative; }
.wn-search-row input {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 420px;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.9rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
  margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
}
.wn-hint {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: #999;
  margin: 0 0 0.9rem;
}
.wn-chips {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;

  margin-bottom: 1.3rem;
  min-height: 2rem;

  background: #2d4a8c;

  border-color: #2d4a8c;
}

  font-size: 0.85rem;

<div class="wn-header">
  <div class="wn-title">🔍 <span>관심 종목 뉴스 검색기</span></div>
  <p class="wn-sub">코스피·코스닥 전 종목을 대상으로 실시간 검색</p>
</div>

<div class="wn-search-row">
  <input type="text" id="wn-search" placeholder="종목명 또는 종목코드로 검색 (예: 삼성전자, 005930, HLB)" autocomplete="off">
</div>
<p class="wn-hint" id="wn-hint">종목명이나 종목코드 일부를 입력해보세요.</p>

<div class="wn-chips" id="wn-chips"></div>

<div id="wn-result"></div>

<p class="wn-footnote">
  검색은 코스피·코스닥 상장 전 종목(약 2,900개)을 대상으로 하며, 결과를 고르면 그 종목의 최신 뉴스를 그 자리에서 가져옵니다
  (짧은 시간 내 같은 종목을 다시 조회하면 캐시된 결과가 표시될 수 있습니다).
  뉴스는 <a href="https://finance.naver.com/item/main.naver?code=005930" target="_blank" rel="noopener">네이버 증권 종목 뉴스</a>에 노출되는 제목·날짜를 그대로 가져온 것이며,
  본문은 각 언론사 원문 링크에서 확인할 수 있습니다. 본 정보는 참고용이며 투자 결정의 책임은 본인에게 있습니다.
</p>

<script>
(function () {
  // Replace with the deployed Cloudflare Worker URL from
  // cloudflare-worker/stock-search-worker.js (see that file's header comment
  // for deploy steps). A static site can't call finance.naver.com directly
  // from the browser (no CORS there), so this small proxy does it instead.
  const WORKER_URL = "__CONFIGURE_WORKER_URL__";

  const searchInput = document.getElementById("wn-search");
  const hint = document.getElementById("wn-hint");
  const chips = document.getElementById("wn-chips");
  const result = document.getElementById("wn-result");
  let activeCode = null;
  let debounceTimer = null;
  let searchSeq = 0;

  function escapeHtml(str) {
    return String(str).replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({
      "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;",
    }[c]));
  }

  function workerConfigured() {
    return !WORKER_URL.startsWith("__CONFIGURE");
  }

  async function runSearch(q) {
    const mySeq = ++searchSeq;
    if (!q) {
      chips.innerHTML = "";
      hint.textContent = "종목명이나 종목코드 일부를 입력해보세요.";
      return;
    }
    hint.textContent = "검색 중…";
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${WORKER_URL}/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`);
      if (mySeq !== searchSeq) return; // a newer keystroke already started another search
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
      const data = await res.json();
      renderChips(data.results || []);
      hint.textContent = data.results && data.results.length
        ? `${data.results.length}개 종목이 검색되었습니다.`
        : "일치하는 종목이 없습니다.";
    } catch (err) {
      if (mySeq !== searchSeq) return;
      chips.innerHTML = "";
      hint.textContent = `검색 서비스에 연결하지 못했습니다: ${err.message}`;
    }
  }

  function renderChips(stocks) {
    if (!stocks.length) {
      chips.innerHTML = "";
      return;
    }
    chips.innerHTML = stocks.map((s) => `
      <button type="button" class="wn-chip${s.code === activeCode ? " wn-active" : ""}" data-code="${escapeHtml(s.code)}" data-name="${escapeHtml(s.name)}">
        ${escapeHtml(s.name)}<span class="wn-chip-market">${escapeHtml(s.market === "KSQ" ? "코스닥" : "코스피")}</span>
      </button>
    `).join("");
    chips.querySelectorAll(".wn-chip").forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        activeCode = btn.dataset.code;
        chips.querySelectorAll(".wn-chip").forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle("wn-active", b === btn));
        loadNews(btn.dataset.code, btn.dataset.name);
      });
    });
  }

  async function loadNews(code, name) {
    result.innerHTML = `<div class="wn-result-head">${escapeHtml(name)} 뉴스</div><p class="wn-empty">불러오는 중입니다…</p>`;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${WORKER_URL}/news?code=${encodeURIComponent(code)}`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
      const stock = await res.json();
      if (stock.error) throw new Error(stock.error);
      if (!stock.items || !stock.items.length) {
        result.innerHTML = `<div class="wn-result-head">${escapeHtml(name)} 뉴스</div><p class="wn-empty">최근 수집된 뉴스가 없습니다.</p>`;
        return;
      }
      result.innerHTML = `
        <div class="wn-result-head">${escapeHtml(name)} 뉴스</div>
        <ul class="wn-list">${stock.items.map((it) => `
          <li class="wn-item">
            <h3><span class="wn-rank">${it.rank}</span><a href="${escapeHtml(it.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${escapeHtml(it.title)}</a></h3>
            <div class="wn-item-meta">${escapeHtml(it.time || "")}</div>
          </li>`).join("")}</ul>`;
    } catch (err) {
      result.innerHTML = `<div class="wn-result-head">${escapeHtml(name)} 뉴스</div><p class="wn-error">뉴스를 가져오지 못했습니다: ${escapeHtml(err.message)}</p>`;
    }
  }

  searchInput.addEventListener("input", () => {
    clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
    const q = searchInput.value.trim();
    debounceTimer = setTimeout(() => runSearch(q), 300);
  });

  if (!workerConfigured()) {
    hint.textContent = "검색 서비스가 아직 연결되지 않았습니다 (관리자 설정 필요).";
    searchInput.disabled = true;
  }
})();
</script>
```
